metadata.selection_rationale: USER SELECTED 2026-09-28: WCP-2007 option 1 (D_fixed_M0) for HS_071, EEZ_941 and EEZ_598. Explicit experimental variant preserves juvenile other-mortality flows and changes Small BET P/B to 1.4129713563375232, EE to 0.7898725981469387; Small YFT P/B to 2.5304972811160384, EE to 0.8816702937266387. GE, TE and With Egestion all WARN; PP-budget checks OK, but strict mass balance remains false (adult BET residual 0.727940%). This is an adopted surrogate, not an author-confirmed correction or a region-specific native EwE model. Original source remains preserved. Griffiths 2019 source and pooled variant are retained for later investigation of failures, not selected.
